intro: PowerEdge generations arrived in waves. The year below marks the first documented launch wave; individual Intel, AMD, modular, edge and GPU models can follow later. Announcement dates do not guarantee that every configuration shipped that year.

generations.label: PowerEdge 14G
generations.summary: R640/R740-era platforms began in 2017. Individual models and later CPU refreshes arrived across the generation.

generations.label: PowerEdge 15G
generations.summary: Early AMD models such as R6515/R7515 arrived in 2019. The broad 15G launch, including Intel R650/R750, followed in March 2021.

generations.label: PowerEdge 16G
generations.summary: AMD R66x5/R76x5 platforms were announced in November 2022; the Intel R660/R760-era expansion followed in 2023. MX760c and T560 are also 16G.

generations.label: PowerEdge 17G
generations.summary: R670/R770 CSP Editions were announced in May 2024; AMD racks followed in October. Intel E-core and P-core configurations rolled out across 2024–2025, with AI and edge models continuing afterward.

r470.note: Dell’s December 2024 announcement lists R470 as available with Xeon 6 E-cores. P-core configurations were highlighted in the April 2025 expansion.

r570.note: Introduced in December 2024 with launch planned for early 2025. P-core configurations were highlighted in April 2025.

r670.note: The CSP Edition was announced in May 2024 with Xeon 6 E-cores. The broader P-core configuration wave followed in April 2025; not every current build was available at the first announcement.

r770.note: The CSP Edition was announced in May 2024 with Xeon 6 E-cores. The broader P-core configuration wave followed in April 2025; not every current build was available at the first announcement.

r6715.note: Announced 10 October 2024; the launch release targeted global availability from November 2024.

r7715.note: Announced 10 October 2024; the launch release targeted global availability from November 2024.

r6725.note: Announced 10 October 2024; the launch release targeted global availability from November 2024.

r7725.note: Announced 10 October 2024; the launch release targeted global availability from November 2024.

mx760.note: Dell published this model as a new 16G compute sled in March 2023. The MX7000 enclosure is an older platform that spans several sled generations.

t560.note: Model-specific Dell documents date to May 2023. Later processor support does not restart the model’s age; an exact launch day is not asserted.

xr8720.note: Announced September 2025 with global availability planned for Q1 2026. The compute sled’s date differs from the older XR8000 chassis.

xe7740.note: Announced November 2024, with availability then planned for the first half of 2025. Later GPU qualifications are separate milestones.

xe7745.note: Announced October 2024, with availability then planned from January 2025. This is the model announcement year, not a claim that every GPU option shipped in 2024.

xe9680.note: Announced November 2022; the release planned availability in the first half of 2023. Later CPU and accelerator configurations do not make it a new server generation.

xe9780.note: Announced May 2025 in the next wave of eight-GPU platforms. Check configuration-specific accelerator and cooling qualifications.

xe9785l.note: Announced May 2025; AMD MI350-series configurations were part of this announcement. Shipping milestones and GPU options vary by build.

xe9785.note: The air-cooled XE9785 was announced in the 2025 platform wave; November 2025 SC25 materials described the MI355X build and targeted global availability in December. GPU refreshes are separate from model age.

r7625.note: Named in the 10 November 2022 AMD launch. Wider availability was planned for February 2023; model introduction is not an availability guarantee.

r7615.note: Named in the 10 November 2022 AMD launch. Wider availability was planned for February 2023; model introduction is not an availability guarantee.

r7515.note: R7515 was available at the 17 September 2019 EPYC 7002 announcement. EPYC 7003 configurations were available by March 2021.

r7525.note: Named in the 17 September 2019 announcement; availability was then planned for early 2020, so 2019 is not a shipment date. EPYC 7003 configurations were available by March 2021.
